business_problem: Mercedes-Benz wanted to make its in-car "Hey Mercedes" voice control more intuitive than a predefined-command assistant so drivers and passengers could ask broader, more complex questions and still interact hands-free while driving.
solution_summary: Mercedes-Benz extended its in-car MBUX Voice Assistant with generative AI by integrating ChatGPT through Azure OpenAI Service. MBUX remains the vehicle-facing assistant that receives "Hey Mercedes" voice prompts and delivers responses inside cars equipped with the MBUX infotainment system, while ChatGPT adds large-language-model capabilities to improve natural language understanding and handle broader conversational requests such as destination questions, recipe suggestions, and other complex prompts. The beta is activated over the air for eligible U.S. vehicles, and customers can opt in through the Mercedes me app or directly from the vehicle. Mercedes-Benz states that voice command data is stored in the Mercedes-Benz Intelligent Cloud, where it is anonymised and analysed under Mercedes-controlled IT processes. Developer insights from beta requests are then used to prioritize assistant improvements and shape rollout to additional markets and languages.

solution_components.name: MBUX Voice Assistant
solution_components.role: Serves as the in-car voice interface that receives driver requests and delivers conversational responses inside the vehicle.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides large-language-model capabilities that expand natural language understanding and answer broader or more complex user questions.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Hosts the ChatGPT integration with Microsoft cloud security, privacy, and reliability controls for the beta deployment.

solution_components.name: Mercedes-Benz Intelligent Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores collected voice command data so Mercedes-Benz can anonymise and analyse requests from the beta programme.

data_flow: Drivers speak to the MBUX Voice Assistant in eligible vehicles, which passes conversational requests to ChatGPT through Azure OpenAI Service for richer language understanding and answer generation. Responses are returned to the in-car assistant, while collected voice command data is stored in the Mercedes-Benz Intelligent Cloud, where it is anonymised and analysed for product improvement and rollout planning.
business_outcome: Mercedes-Benz gave beta users a more conversational in-car assistant capable of more comprehensive answers, while its developers gained request-level insight to improve voice control and plan rollout to more markets and languages.
